edit.old:
Finer values (`inceptive`, `directed-activity`, `semelfactive`, ...) exist in the full guideline; use them
only when they are clear.
- Roles (3): 美国小报 → `:place (c / country ...)`; 电视节目 → `(p / 节目 :medium (t / 电视))`; 都经过 → `(j / 经-01 :mod (d / 都))`.
- 由于 (2.5): 由于…内容 → `:reason (c / 内容 ...)`.
- Aspect (4.1): 发行 (a paper's publishing) → `:aspect habitual`; 已经停止发行的 → 停止 `:aspect state`; 被称为 → `:aspect performance`.
- Temporal (5.1): 富-01 under have-degree-91 → `(s5main :overlap s5f)`.
- No invented owner (3): 发行网络版 → `(f / 发行-01 :ARG1 (w / 网络版))`.
- Inner and (3): 奇闻轶事、传奇与新闻 → `(a / and :op1 (a2 / and :op1 奇闻 :op2 轶事) :op2 传奇 :op3 新闻)`.

- Aspect (4.1): 曾经拥有过 → `:aspect state`; 纸本已经停刊 → `:aspect performance`; clause-level identity-91 → `:aspect state`; appositive identity-91, have-org-role-91, have-quant-91 → no aspect, no modal triple.
- Entity type (2.1): 该周报 → `(z / 周报 :mod (g / 该))`, not `newspaper`.
- have-degree-91 (4.1): no `:aspect` on it and no triples for it; only 富-01 gets `(s5main :overlap s5f)` and `(author :full-affirmative s5f)`.
- Main event (5.1): 停止发行/拥有过 → `(document-creation-time :before e)`; 被称为 → `(document-creation-time :depends-on e)`; 以…而闻名 → `(闻名 :contained 发行)`.
- 曾经 (3): 曾经拥有过 → `:temporal (c / 曾经)`.
- Preposition (3): 至2007年 → `:temporal (d / date-entity :year 2007)`, no 至 node.

edit.anchor: A sentence-initial 不过/但是 that contrasts with the previous sentence gets no node, and the sentence's main verb is the root;
edit.text: 虽然/尽管 X，不过/但是/却 Y in one sentence → `but-91 :ARG1 X :ARG2 Y`, no `:concession`;

edit.old: *although* (虽然, 尽管) → `:concession`.
edit.new: *although* (虽然, 尽管) without 不过/但是 → `:concession`.

edit.anchor: Keep `:reason`/`:purpose` roles only for phrase-level modifiers.
edit.text:
- 以 X 为目的 → `identity-91 :ARG1 (目的 :purpose-of V) :ARG2 X :aspect state`, not have-purpose-91; X (博君一笑) has no sense.
- 后来/然后/接着 joining clauses → `(consecutive :op1 … :op2 …)`; the connective and 还/就 there get no node.

X (都)是 Adj 的 → `have-mod-91 :ARG1 X :ARG2 (Adj)`; the Adj has no sense, aspect or triples. A parenthetical gloss N：「Y」 → `identity-91 :ARG1 N :ARG2 Y :aspect state`, joined by `and` to the neighbouring clause, never `:medium`. 第一夫人 → `have-rel-role-91 :ARG3 (第一夫人 :place country)`, not have-org-role...

edit.anchor: In Chinese documents, a named person, or a personal pronoun for one individual (他, 她), is `individual-person`, not `person`.
edit.text: 他们/它们 for an organisation or paper of the same sentence is that node's variable; in a later sentence it is a `person` node linked by `:same-entity`.

edit.anchor: they are the first and last `:opN`.
edit.text: So is the middle dot (希拉里·克林顿 → `:op2 "·"`). A bare category noun before a foreign name (外星人 P'Lod) is the concept (`外星人 :name …`), not an appositive identity-91. 地球 → `planet :name`.

edit.old: - 其中 → `:mod (其中)` on the noun it introduces, not `:part`.
edit.new:
- 其中 → `:mod (其中)` on the noun it introduces, not `:part`; with a superlative (其中最大宗) it is `:ARG5` of have-degree-91, and the head is `implicit-argument :unit 宗`.
- X 与/和/跟 Y 有关系 → `有-03 :ARG0 (and :op1 X :op2 Y)`, not `:companion`.
- N 有 A、B…等 listing N's kinds → `N :example (and …)`, no 有 node.
-...

edit.old:
Reported speech and thought: the reported event is the `:ARG1` of the reporting verb, as in AMR. The
UMR release data also marks it with `:quote <reporting event>` when the content is a quotation.
edit.new: Reported speech and thought: the reported event is the `:ARG1` of the reporting verb, as in AMR. The content node (of 宣称/指/说, or a slogan's content under identity-91) always gets `:quote <reporting event or identity node>`, and the speaker gets `(speaker :full-affirmative content)`.

edit.old: - Within one sentence, coreference is a re-entrancy in the graph (one variable), not a `:coref` triple.
edit.new: - Within one sentence, pronouns, zero arguments and 自己/其 are re-entrancies. A repeated noun (周报 after the named paper, 该刊) always gets its own node, even in the same sentence, linked by `:same-entity`. No `:subset-of` without a clearly stated set.

edit.anchor: A participle of a completed earlier event (遗留下来的) is `performance`.
edit.text: - Overriding the habitual rule: an event noun under 停止/开始/继续 (停止…的发行) is `process`, with the aspectual verb's agent re-entered as its ARG0; under 继续 the subject is ARG0 of both verbs. 生存, 存在 → `state`. Verb + result complement (创造出) → `performance`.

edit.anchor: - Every event has `:aspect`; negated events have `:polarity -`.
edit.text: - Every named person in a Chinese document is `individual-person`. Plain concepts with no sense (真实, 博君一笑, 中) get no temporal or modal triple.

- 虽然…不过 (2.5): 虽然他们宣称X（标语：Y），不过大部分报导以博君一笑为目的 → `(b / but-91 :ARG1 (a / and :op1 宣称 :op2 (i / identity-91 :ARG1 标语 :ARG2 Y)) :ARG2 (i2 / identity-91 :ARG1 (m / 目的 :purpose-of 报导) :ARG2 (g / 博君一笑)))`.
- 是…的 (2.3): 都是真实的 → `(h / have-mod-91 :ARG2 (t / 真实) :mod (d / 都) :aspect state)`.
- Name (2.2): 外星...
